verses.text: In the second year of Darius, in the eighth month, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying:
The Lord was exceedingly displeased with your fathers.
Therefore, say to them: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Return to Me, says the Lord of hosts, and I will return to you, says the Lord of hosts.

The former prophets spoke to your fathers, saying: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Return from your evil ways and from your evil deeds. But they did not hear, nor did they heed Me, says the Lord. Do not be like your fathers, says the Lord of hosts.
Where are your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?

My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, did they not overtake your fathers? And they returned and said: The Lord of hosts has dealt with us according to our ways and according to our deeds, so He has dealt with us.
In the second year of Darius, in the eighth month, on the twenty-fourth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying:
And behold, I saw a man riding on a red horse, and it stood among the myrtle trees in the hollow; and behind it were horses, red, sorrel, and white.
Then I said: My lord, what are these? And the angel who talked with me said to me: I will show you what they are.
So the man who stood among the myrtle trees answered and said: These are the ones whom the Lord has sent to walk to and fro throughout the earth.
And among the trees of the forest stood the angel of the Lord, who had returned to the earth, and behold, the whole earth was silent, saying, "It is established."
And the angel of the Lord returned and said, "O Lord of hosts, how long will You not have mercy on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, against which You have been angry for these seventy years?"
And the Lord answered the angel who spoke with me with good and comforting words.
Therefore, the angel who spoke with me said, "Thus says the Lord of hosts: 'I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with great jealousy.'"
I was greatly troubled, for they had inflicted harm upon me, and I was indeed troubled among the nations that had not troubled them.
Therefore, the Lord says, "I will return to Jerusalem with mercy; My house shall be built in it," says the Lord of hosts, "and a measuring line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem."
Furthermore, he said, "Thus says the Lord of hosts: 'My cities shall again overflow with prosperity, and the Lord will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.'"
And I lifted my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.
And the angel who spoke with me said, "What are these?" And I said, "These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem."
And the Lord showed me four craftsmen.

And I said: What is it that these have come to do? And he answered me: A man shall not rise until he is brought low; these are the days of Judah that have been brought low, but these shall terrify them, for they shall be brought low in the land of Judah, and they have come to seek the days of the nations that have been brought low. Thus he spoke.
ዓይኖቼንም አነሣሁ፣ እነሆም፥ በእጁ የመለኪያ ገመድ የያዘ አንድ ሰውን አየሁ።
እኔም፦ አንተ ወዴት ትሄዳለህ? አልሁ። እርሱም፦ የኢየሩሳሌምን ወርድና ርዝመት ስንት መሆኑን ሰፍሬ አይ ዘንድ እሄዳለሁ አለኝ።
እነሆም፥ ከእኔ ጋር ይነጋገር የነበረው መልአክ ወጣ፥ ሌላም መልአክ ሊገናኘው ወጣ፥ እንዲህም አለው፦
ሩጥ፥ ይህንም ጕልማሳ እንዲህ በለው፦ ኢየሩሳሌም በውስጥዋ ካሉት ሰዎችና እንስሶች ብዛት የተነሣ ቅጥር እንደሌላቸው መንደሮች ሆና ትኖራለች።
እኔ በዙሪያዋ የእሳት ቅጥር እሆንላታለሁ፥ በውስጥዋም ክብርን እሆናለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
እናንተ ሆይ፥ ከሰሜን ምድር ሽሹ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፣ እንደ አራቱ የሰማይ ነፋሳት በትኛችኋለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
አንቺ ከባቢሎን ሴት ልጅ ጋር የምትኖሪ ጽዮን ሆይ፥ ኰብልዪ።
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና፦ ከክብሩ በኋላ ወደ በዘበዙአችሁ አሕዛብ ልኮኛል፣ የሚነካችሁ የዓይኑን ብሌን የሚነካ ነውና።
እነሆ፥ እጄን በላያቸው አወዛውዛለሁ፥ ተገዝተው ለነበሩት ብዝበዛ ይሆናሉ፣ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ላከኝ ታውቃላችሁ።
የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ መጥቼ በመካከልሽ እኖራለሁና ዘምሪ ደስም ይበልሽ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

And in that day, many nations shall seek the Lord God, and the people shall be gathered unto Him; and I shall dwell in the midst of you, for the Lord of hosts, the Lord God, shall be known unto you as He who has sent me unto you.
The Lord shall grant Judah a portion, and He shall bring it into the holy land, and He shall choose Jerusalem again.
The Lord has risen from His holy dwelling; therefore, let all flesh be silent before Him.
And he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the Angel of the Lord, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
And the Lord said unto Satan: "The Lord rebuke thee, O Satan; the Lord that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?"
And Joshua was clothed with filthy garments and stood before the angel.

And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying: "Take away the filthy garments from him." And unto him he said: "Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment."
Moreover he said: "Let them set a fair mitre upon his head." So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the Lord stood by.
And the angel of the Lord protested unto Joshua, saying:

Thus saith the Lord of hosts: "If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by."
Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for behold, I will bring forth my servant the Branch.

For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.
And the angel that had been speaking with me returned and awakened me, as a man is awakened from his sleep.

And he said unto me, "What seest thou?" And I said, "Behold, I see a lampstand all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the lamps which are upon the top thereof."
Two olive trees are by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof."
And the angel that talked with me came again, and awakened me, and said, "What are these, my lord?" And I said, "I know not."
And the angel that talked with me answered and said, "Knowest thou not what these be?" And I said, "No, my lord."
Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, "This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, 'Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.'"
O great mountain, who art thou before Zerubbabel? Thou shalt become a plain; and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, "Grace, grace unto it!"
And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
"The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you."

For who hath despised the day of small things? For they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the Lord, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
And I answered, "What are these two olive trees that stand on the right side and on the left side of the lampstand?" And I said, "I do not know."
And I answered again, "What are these two branches of the olive trees that are beside the two golden pipes, from which the golden oil flows?" And I said, "I do not know."
And he answered me, "Do you not know what these are?" I said, "No, my Lord."
And he said, "These are the two anointed ones, who stand by the Lord of the whole earth."
I lifted up my eyes, and behold, I saw a scroll flying.
And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I see a flying scroll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.

Then said I unto him, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth; for every thief shall be expelled on this side according to it, and every false swearer shall be expelled on that side according to it.

I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
And the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.
And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. Moreover, he said, This is their resemblance throughout the earth.
And behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead, and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.
And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.

Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
And He said: "They shall dwell in the house of Senaar, for they shall be taken there; and when the time is prepared, there shall He abide in that place."
And I lifted my eyes, and behold, four chariots came forth from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot were black horses.
And in the third chariot were white horses; and in the fourth chariot were dappled horses.
And I spoke with the angel that talked with me, saying, My lord, what are these? And the angel answered and said unto me,
These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the dappled go forth toward the south country.
And the strong horses went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth; and he said, Go, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
Then cried he upon me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon; and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah.
Take silver and gold from them, and also the work of the craftsmen; and let them be brought before the great priest, the son of Jehoiada, in the head of Jehoash, and let them say thus:
Thus saith the Lord God of hosts: Behold, a man named Jehoiada shall be found in his place, and he shall serve in the house of the Lord.
He shall serve in the house of the Lord, and he shall carry honor; and he shall be set upon the throne, and he shall be a priest upon the throne, and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
And the craftsmen shall be for Helim and for Tobiah, for Jedaiah and for Zephaniah, and for the son of Hen, to be for a memorial in the house of the Lord.
And those who are far off shall come and serve in the house of the Lord; and the Lord God of hosts shall send unto you as I have sent you. And if you heed the word of your God, this shall be so.
In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah.
The men of Bethel, Sarasar and Regemelech, sent their men to pray before the Lord, saying,
To the priests of the house of the Lord and to the prophets: "Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?" Thus they spoke to me.
And the word of the Lord of hosts came unto me, saying,
Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, "When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?"
When ye did eat and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?

And the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah, saying, "Should ye not hear the words which the Lord hath cried by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?"
The word of the Lord came unto Zechariah, saying,
Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, "Execute true judgment, and show mercy and compassion every man to his brother;
And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart."
But they turned their backs and did not listen, and they made their ears heavy, that they should not hear.

The Lord of hosts, the Lord God, sent His law and His word by the hand of the prophets who were before, but their hearts were hardened like flint, that they should not hear; therefore, great wrath came from the Lord of hosts, the Lord God.
When I called, they did not listen to me; likewise, when they called, I did not hear them, says the Lord of hosts, the Lord God.

And to all the nations that they did not know, He blew upon them with a mighty wind. Thus, after them, the land became desolate, and there was neither a passerby nor a traveler; the land that was pleasant was made desolate.
The Lord of hosts, the word of the Lord God came to me, saying this:
The Lord of hosts, God says this: Concerning Zion, I have great jealousy; with great wrath, I have great wrath for her.

The Lord says this: I will return to Zion and dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and Jerusalem shall be called the faithful city, the holy mountain, the mountain of the Lord of hosts, the holy mountain.
The Lord of hosts, God says this: Old men and old women shall sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each one with staff in hand because of great age.
And the streets of the city shall be filled with boys and girls playing in its streets.
The Lord of hosts, God says this: If it is marvelous in the eyes of this people, should it also be marvelous in My eyes? says the Lord of hosts.
The Lord of hosts, God says this: Behold, I will save My people from the east country and from the west country;
I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God in truth and righteousness.

The Lord of hosts, God says this: The temple shall be built, and from the day that the Lord of hosts laid the foundation of His house, you have heard this word from the mouths of the prophets in this time: Lift up your hands.
For before those days, there was no wage for man or any wage for beast; and I set all men, one against another, and there was no peace for him who went out or came in.
አሁን ግን እንደ ቀደመው ዘመን በዚህ ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ላይ አልሆንም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር።
ነገር ግን ሰላምን እዘራለሁ፣ ወይኑ ፍሬውን ይሰጣል፥ ምድርም አዝመራዋን ታወጣለች፥ ሰማያትም ጠላቸውን ይሰጣሉ፣ ለዚህም ሕዝብ ቅሬታ ይህን ነገር ሁሉ አወርሳለሁ።
የይሁዳ ቤትና የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ እርግማን እንደ ነበራችሁ፥ እንዲሁ አድናችኋለሁ፥ በረከትም ትሆናላችሁ፣ አትፍሩ፥ እጃችሁንም አበርቱ።
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላልና፦ አባቶቻችሁ እጅግ ባስቈጡኝ ጊዜ ክፉ ለማድረግ እንዳሰብሁ፥ እንዳልተጸጸትሁም፥ ይላል የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር፥
እንዲሁ ዳግመኛ ለኢየሩሳሌምና ለይሁዳ ቤት በዚህ ወራት በጎነትን አደርግ ዘንድ አስቤአለሁ፣ አትፍሩ።
የምትሠሩት ነገር ይህ ነው፣ እያንዳንዳችሁ ከባልንጀራችሁ ጋር እውነትን ተነጋገሩ፣ በበር አደባባያችሁም የእውነትንና የሰላምን ፍርድ ፍረዱ፣
ሁላችሁም በባልንጀራችሁ ላይ ክፉን ነገር በልባችሁ አታስቡ፣ የሐሰትንም መሐላ አትውደዱ፣ ይህን ነገር ሁሉ እጠላለሁና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
የሠራዊት ጌታ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እኔ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ፦
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ የአራተኛው ወር ጾም የአምስተኛውም የሰባተኛውም የአሥረኛውም ወር ጾም ለይሁዳ ቤት ደስታና ተድላ የሐሤትም በዓላት ይሆናል፣ ስለዚህም እውነትንና ሰላምን ውደዱ።
የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ በብዙ ከተሞች የሚቀመጡ አሕዛብ ገና ይመጣሉ፣
In a certain city, the people say: "Let us call upon the Lord our God, and let us seek the Lord of hosts; come, let us go, and I too will go," and they journey to another city.
Many nations and mighty ones shall gather in Jerusalem to seek the Lord of hosts, and they shall come to call upon the Lord.

Thus saith the Lord of hosts: "In that time, from every tongue of the nations, ten men shall take hold of the garment of a Jewish man, saying: 'We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.'"
The word of the Lord is a burden upon the land of Sidon; it shall rest upon Damascus. The eyes of the Lord are toward man and toward all the paths of Israel.
Furthermore, at her gate, she is set upon by the wise; truly, they are very cunning upon Tyre and upon Sidon.
Tyre has built a fortress for herself; her riches are like dust, and her fine gold is like mire in the streets.
Behold, the Lord shall cast her down; He shall smite her strength upon the sea, and she shall be consumed with fire.

Ashkelon shall not be afraid, nor shall Gaza; indeed, she shall greatly tremble, and likewise Ekron, for her hope shall perish; and her king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not find a dwelling.
The forsaken people shall dwell in Azal, and I will cause the pride of the Philistines to cease.

I will cast out her blood from my mouth, and I will take away her abominations from between my teeth; and she shall be a sacrifice to our God; in Judah, she shall be like a leader, and Ekron shall be like a Jebusite.
I too will encamp around my house as a guard, that none may go in or out; and now, I cannot see with my eyes, and after this, let none be dismayed.

O daughter of Zion, rejoice greatly! O daughter of Jerusalem, shout aloud! Behold, your King comes to you; He is just and having salvation, lowly and riding upon an ass, upon a colt the foal of an ass.

I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow shall be cut off, and He shall speak peace to the nations; and His dominion shall be from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.
And for thee, concerning thy covenant, I have poured out thy blood, as water from a pit where there is no water.
O ye captives who dwell in hope, return unto the stronghold; I shall speak unto you today, that I may make you twofold.
I have made Judah my bow; I have filled it with Ephraim; O Zion, I have raised thy children against the children of Greece; and I will make thee as a mighty man of war.
And the Lord shall be seen over them, and His arrow shall go forth as the lightning; and the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with the whirlwinds of the south.

The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour and subdue them; and they shall tread down the stones of the streets, as wine is trodden; and they shall be filled like bowls, as the corners of the altar.
And in that day, their God, the Lord, shall save them, as the flock of His people; for they shall be as the jewels of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon His land.
How great is His goodness! And how great is His beauty! Corn shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the maids.
በኋለኛው ዝናብ ጊዜ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ዝናቡን ለምኑ፣ እግዚአብሔር መብረቅ ያደርጋል፣ እርሱም የበልግ ዝናብን ለእያንዳንዱም በሜዳ ውስጥ ሣርን ይሰጣል።
ተራፊም ከንቱነትን ተናግረዋልና፥ ምዋርተኞችም ውሸትን አይተዋልና፣ ሕልምንም የሚያዩ በሐሰት ተናግረዋል፥ በከንቱም ያጽናናሉ፣ እረኛም የላቸውምና እንደ በጎች ተቅበዝብዘዋል ተጨንቀውማል።
ቍጣዬ በእረኞች ላይ ነድዶአል፥ አውራ ፍየሎችንም እቀጣለሁ፣ የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም የይሁዳን ቤት መንጋውን ጐብኝቶአል፥ በሰልፍም ውስጥ እንዳለ እንደ ክብሩ ፈረስ ያደርጋቸዋል።
ከእርሱ ዘንድ የማዕዘኑ ድንጋይ፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ ችንካሩ፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ የሰልፍ ቀስት፥ ከእርሱም ዘንድ አስገባሪው ሁሉ በአንድ ላይ ይመጣሉ።
በሰልፍም ጊዜ ጠላቶቻቸውን በመንገድ ጭቃ ውስጥ እንደሚረግጡ ኃያላን ይሆናሉ፣ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ነውና ይዋጋሉ፥ ፈረሰኞችም ያፍራሉ።
ወድጃቸዋለሁና የይሁዳን ቤት አበረታለሁ፥ የዮሴፍንም ቤት አድናለሁ፣ አደላድላቸዋለሁም፣ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፣ እኔም አምላካቸው እግዚአብሔር ነኝና፥ እኔም እሰማቸዋለሁና እንዳልጣልኋቸው ይሆናሉ።
የኤፍሬምም ሰዎች እንደ ኃያላን ይሆናሉ፥ ልባቸውም የወይን ጠጅ እንደ ጠጣ ሰው ደስ ይለዋል፣ ልጆቻቸውም አይተው ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ ልባቸውም በእግዚአብሔር ሐሤት ያደርጋል።
ተቤዥቼአቸዋለሁና በፉጨት ጠርቼ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፣ ቀድሞም በዝተው እንደ ነበሩ ይበዛሉ።
በአሕዛብም መካከል ብዘራቸው እንኳ በሩቅ አገር ሳሉ ያስቡኛል፥ ከልጆቻቸውም ጋር በሕይወት ይኖራሉ፥ ይመለሱማል።
ከግብጽም ምድር እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥ ከአሦርም እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፣ ወደ ገለዓድና ወደ ሊባኖስ ምድር አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ የሚበቃም ቦታ አይገኝላቸውም።

He shall not pass through the sea of anguish, and the path of the sea shall be struck; all the depths of the river shall be brought to an end; the pride of Assyria shall be brought low, and the might of Egypt shall be humbled.
I will strengthen them in their God; they shall walk in His name, says the Lord.
ሊባኖስ ሆይ፥ ደጆችህን ክፈት፥ እሳትም ዝግባዎችህን ትብላ።
የጥድ ዛፍ ሆይ፥ ዝግባ ወድቆአልና፥ ከበርቴዎችም ጠፍተዋልና ዋይ በል፣ እናንተም የባሳን ዛፎች ሆይ፥ ጽኑው ጫካ ተቈርጦአልና ዋይ በሉ።
የእረኞች ክብር ተዋርዶአልና የዋይታቸው ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል፣ የዮርዳኖስ ትዕቢት ተዋርዶአልና የአንበሶች ግሣት ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።
አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎአል፦ ለእርድ የሚሆኑትን በጎች ጠብቅ።
የገዙአቸው ያርዱአቸዋል፥ ራሳቸውንም እንደ በደለኞች አድርገው አይቈጥሩም፣ የሸጡአቸውም፦ ባለ ጠጋ ሆነዋልና እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን ይላሉ፣ እረኞቻቸውም አይራሩላቸውም።
ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በምድር ላይ ለሚኖሩ አልራራም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፣ እነሆም፥ ሰውን ሁሉ በባልንጀራውና በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፣ ምድሪቱም ይመታሉ፥ ከእጃቸውም አላድናቸውም።
እኔም ለእርድ የሚሆኑትን በጎች፥ የመንጋውን ችግረኞች ጠበቅሁ። ሁለት በትሮችንም ወሰድሁ፣ የአንዲቱን ስም ውበት የሁለተኛይቱንም ስም ማሰሪያ ብዬ ጠራሁ፣ መንጋውንም ጠበቅሁ።
በአንድ ወርም ሦስቱን እረኞች አጠፋሁ፣ ነፍሴም ተሰቀቀቻቸው፥ ነፍሳቸውም ደግሞ እኔን ጠላች።
እኔም፦ እናንተን አልጠብቅም፣ የሚሞተው ይሙት፥ የሚጠፋውም ይጥፋ፣ የቀረውም እያንዳንዱ የባልንጀራውን ሥጋ ይብላ አልሁ።
እኔም ከሕዝቦች ሁሉ ጋር የገባሁትን ቃል ኪዳኔን አፈርስ ዘንድ ውበት የተባለችውን በትሬን ወስጄ ቈረጥሁ።
And on that day it was broken; likewise, those who looked upon me, the oppressors, knew that the word of the Lord was as it had been.
And I said: "If you are pleased, give me my price; but if not, I will not." And they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
And the Lord said unto me: "Cast it unto the potter, a goodly price that I was prized at by them." And I took the thirty pieces of silver and cast them in the house of the Lord to the potter.
And I will break the brotherhood that is between Judah and Israel, and I will take the second staff, which is called Union, and I will cut it in two.
And the Lord said unto me: "Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd."

Behold, I have raised up a shepherd in the land; he shall not visit that which is lost, nor seek that which is driven away, nor heal that which is broken; but he shall eat the flesh of the fat and tear their claws in pieces.
Woe to the idle shepherd that leaveth the flock! The sword shall be upon his arm and upon his right eye; his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
ስለ እስራኤል የተነገረ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሸክም ይህ ነው። ሰማያትን የዘረጋ፥ ምድርንም የመሠረተ፥ የሰውንም መንፈስ በውስጡ የሠራ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦
እነሆ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን በዙሪያዋ ላሉት ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ የመንገድገድ ዋንጫ አደርጋታለሁ፣ ደግሞም ኢየሩሳሌም ስትከበብ በይሁዳ ላይ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።
በዚያም ቀን ኢየሩሳሌምን ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ ከባድ ድንጋይ አደርጋታለሁ፣ የሚሸከሙአት ሁሉ እጅግ ይቈስላሉ፣ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ በላይዋ ላይ ይከማቻሉ።
በዚያ ቀን፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ፈረስን ሁሉ በድንጋጤ፥ ተቀማጭንም በእብድነት እመታለሁ፣ ዓይኖቼንም በይሁዳ ላይ እከፍታለሁ፥ የአሕዛብንም ፈረሶች ሁሉ በዕውርነት እመታለሁ።
የይሁዳም አለቆች በልባቸው፦ በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩ በአምላካቸው በሠራዊት ጌታ በእግዚአብሔር ብርታት አለ ይላሉ።
በዚያ ቀን የይሁዳን አለቆች በእንጨት መካከል እንዳለ ትንታግ፥ በነዶችም መካከል እንዳለ እንደ ፋና ነበልባል አደርጋቸዋለሁ፣ በቀኝና በግራ በዙሪያ ያሉትን አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይበላሉ፣ ከዚያም ወዲያ ኢየሩሳሌም በስፍራዋ በኢየሩሳሌም ትኖራለች።
እግዚአብሔርም የዳዊት ቤት ክብርና የኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች ክብር በይሁዳ ክብር ላይ እንዳይታበይ የይሁዳን ድንኳኖች አስቀድሞ ያድናል።
በዚያ ቀን እግዚአብሔር በኢየሩሳሌም ለሚኖሩት ይመክትላቸዋል፣ በዚያም ቀን ከእነርሱ መካከል ደካማው እንደ ዳዊት ይሆናል፣ የዳዊትም ቤት በፊታቸው እንደ እግዚአብሔር መልአክ እንደ አምላክ ይሆናል።
በዚያም ቀን በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ የሚመጡትን አሕዛብ ሁሉ ለማጥፋት እጋደላለሁ።
በዳዊትም ቤት ላይ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሚኖሩት ላይ፥ የሞገስንና የልመናን መንፈስ አፈስሳለሁ፣ ወደ እርሱም ወደ ወጉት ይመለከታሉ፣ ሰውም ለአንድያ ልጁ እንደሚያለቅስ ያለቅሱለታል፥ ሰውም ለበኵር ልጁ እንደሚያዝን በመራራ ኅዘን ያዝኑለታል።
On that day, in the valley of Megiddo, as it was, there shall be a great lamentation in Jerusalem, like the lamentation of Hadadrimmon.

The land shall be divided; each tribe shall have its own, the tribe of David shall have its own, and their women shall be for themselves; the tribe of Nathan shall have its own, and their women shall be for themselves;
The tribe of Levi shall have its own, and their women shall be for themselves; the tribe of Simeon shall have its own, and their women shall be for themselves;
All the remaining tribes, each tribe shall have its own, and their women shall be for themselves.
On that day, a fountain shall be opened for the house of David and for the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.

On that day, it shall be said, "The Lord of hosts, I will cut off the names of the idols from the earth, and they shall no longer be remembered; and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to depart from the earth."

And if anyone prophesies, saying, "Your father and mother have borne you; you have spoken lies in the name of the Lord," they shall say, "You shall not live, for you have spoken falsehoods in the name of the Lord," and when he prophesies, his father and mother who bore him shall pierce him through.
And on that day, the prophets shall be ashamed, each one of his vision when he prophesies; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive.
But he shall say, "I am no prophet; I am a tiller of the ground, for I have been made a servant from my youth."
And a man shall say, "What is this wound between your hands?" And he shall answer, "The wound I received in the house of my friends."
O sword, awake against my shepherd, against the man who stands next to me, says the Lord of hosts. Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; I will turn my hand against the little ones.
And in all the land, two-thirds shall be cut off and perish, says the Lord, but one-third shall be left in it.

And I will bring the one-third through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and test them as gold is tested; they will call upon my name, and I will answer them; I will say, "This is my people," and they shall say, "The Lord is my God."
Behold, the day of the Lord shall come, and the plunder shall be in the midst of thee.

I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
And the Lord shall go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

And in that day shall his feet stand upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

And the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal; yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the Lord my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.
And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark.
And it shall be one day which shall be known to the Lord, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.
And the Lord shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Lord, and his name one.

All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king's winepresses shall it be inhabited.
ሰዎችም ይኖሩባታል፥ ከዚያም ወዲያ እርግማን አይሆንም፣ ኢየሩሳሌምም ተዘልላ ትኖራለች።
እግዚአብሔርም ከኢየሩሳሌም ጋር የተዋጉትን አሕዛብ ሁሉ የሚቀሥፍበት ቸነፈር ይህ ነው፣ በእግራቸው ሲቆሙ ሥጋቸው ይበሰብሳል፥ ዓይኖቻቸውም በዓይነስባቸው ውስጥ ይበሰብሳሉ፥ ምላሳቸውም በአፋቸው ውስጥ ይበሰብሳል።
በዚያም ቀን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ታላቅ ሽብር በእነርሱ ላይ ይሆናል፣ እያንዳንዱም የባልንጀራውን እጅ ይይዛል፥ እጁም በባልንጀራው እጅ ላይ ይነሣል።
ይሁዳም ደግሞ በኢየሩሳሌም ውስጥ ሆኖ ይዋጋል፣ በዙሪያም ያሉት የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ሀብት እጅግ ብዙ ወርቅና ብር ልብስም ይሰበሰባል።
በፈረስና በበቅሎ፥ በግመልና በአህያ፥ በዚያም ሰፈር ባለ እንስሳ ሁሉ ላይ የሆነ ቸነፈር እንደዚያ ያለ ቸነፈር ይሆናል።
በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ከመጡት ከአሕዛብ ሁሉ የቀሩት ሁሉ ለንጉሡ ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር ይሰግዱ ዘንድ፥ የዳስ በዓልንም ያከብሩ ዘንድ በየዓመቱ ይወጣሉ።
ከምድርም ወገኖች ሁሉ ለንጉሡ ለሠራዊት ጌታ ለእግዚአብሔር ይሰግዱ ዘንድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ለማይወጡ ለእነርሱ ዝናብ አይዘንብላቸውም።
የግብጽም ወገን ባይወጣ ወደዚያም ባይመጣ፥ እግዚአብሔር የዳስ በዓልን ያከብሩ ዘንድ የማይወጡትን አሕዛብ የሚቀሥፍበት ቸነፈር በእርሱ ላይ ይሆናል።
የግብጽ ቅጣት፥ የዳስ በዓልንም ያከብሩ ዘንድ የማይወጡት የአሕዛብ ሁሉ ቅጣት እንደዚህ ይሆናል።
በዚያ ቀን በፈረሶች ሻኵራ ላይ፦ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ተብሎ ይጻፋል፣ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ያሉ ምንቸቶች በመሠዊያው ፊት እንዳሉ ዳካዎች ይሆናሉ።

In Jerusalem and in Judah, all the places that are set apart for the Lord of hosts, for the Lord God, shall be holy; and all who come to them shall be taken away from among them, and on that day, in the house of the Lord of hosts, there shall no longer be a Canaanite.
